faq.q: What is the Starlite 2045 pre-concert cruise?
faq.a: It is a yacht charter from Puerto Banús that takes place before a Starlite 2045 concert. You board a private boat, cruise the Marbella coastline for 2–3 hours with drinks and snacks, then dock in time to get to the Auditorio for the show. It combines a luxury sailing experience with your concert evening.

faq.q: Which boats are available for the pre-concert cruise?
faq.a: We offer our full fleet, from the 8m Dubhe (5 pax, €749 for 2h) to the 29m Ferretti 94 (12 pax, pricing on request). Tier A boats like the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 are popular for small groups. Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80 include a free jet ski. Contact us via WhatsApp for larger yachts.

faq.q: How long does the pre-concert cruise last?
faq.a: Most guests choose a 2-hour charter, which fits perfectly before a 9pm concert. You depart around 6pm, cruise past the Golden Mile, La Concha, and Cala del Faro, then return to Puerto Banús by 8pm. The 15-minute taxi ride to the Auditorio leaves plenty of time to settle in before the music starts.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, Spanish IVA (21%), water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. For Tier A boats, the price is fixed at €749/2h or €2,299/8h. Tier B boats include a free jet ski. No hidden costs.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food or drinks?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and additional drinks. The boat is equipped with a cooler and glasses. However, the included drinks (beer, wine, cava, soft drinks) are already provided. If you want a catered meal, we can arrange it on request (please enquire via WhatsApp).

faq.q: How do I get from Puerto Banús to the Auditorio Starlite?
faq.a: The Auditorio Starlite is located in the Cantera de Nagüeles, about 6 km from Puerto Banús. A taxi takes 10–15 minutes and costs around €15–20. You can also arrange a private transfer through us. We recommend booking a return taxi in advance to avoid queues after the concert.

Cancellations made 72 hours or more before departure receive a full refund. Between 24 and 72 hours, a 50% refund applies. Within 24 hours, no refund. In case of severe weather, we will offer a full refund or reschedule. Please note that concerts are independent events; check Starlite's own cancellation policy for tickets.

faq.q: Can I book a pre-concert cruise for a large group?
faq.a: Yes, we have boats for up to 12 passengers. The Mangusta 80 (24m), Ferretti 94 (29m), and Maiora 26m all accommodate 12 guests. For groups larger than 12, we can arrange multiple boats. Contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote.

data.body_html:
Combine the glamour of a Starlite 2045 concert with a private yacht charter from Puerto Banús. Our pre-concert cruise lets you sail the Marbella coastline, enjoy drinks and snacks, and arrive at the Auditorio relaxed and ready for the show. With departures from Puerto Banús, a 10-minute taxi ride from the venue, it is the most elegant way to start your evening.

Why choose a pre-concert cruise?

A Starlite concert is a highlight of the Marbella summer, but the evening can be even better with a pre-show sail. You avoid the rush-hour traffic, enjoy the Mediterranean sunset from the water, and arrive at the Auditorio in style. Our boats include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks, so you simply step aboard and relax.

Our fleet for Starlite 2045

We offer a range of boats to suit your group size and budget. All depart from Puerto Banús.

  • Tier A – Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax): €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. Includes skipper, drinks, snacks, IVA.
  • Tier B – Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or Mangusta 80 Grey: from €4,719 for 4 hours, includes a free jet ski.
  • Other boats – Dubhe (8m, 5 pax), Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax), Fairline Targa (12m, 10 pax), Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax), Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), and more. Pricing on request via WhatsApp.

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%).

Sample itinerary for a pre-concert cruise

A typical 2-hour cruise might look like this:

  • 6:00 PM – Board your yacht at Puerto Banús. Meet your skipper and enjoy a welcome drink.
  • 6:15 PM – Depart the marina and head west along the coast. Pass the Golden Mile, with views of La Concha mountain.
  • 6:45 PM – Anchor briefly at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a swim (weather permitting).
  • 7:30 PM – Cruise back towards Puerto Banús, enjoying snacks and drinks.
  • 8:00 PM – Dock at Puerto Banús. Take a taxi to the Auditorio Starlite (10–15 min, ~€15).
  • 9:00 PM – Concert begins.

You can extend the charter to 3 hours for a more relaxed pace, or add dinner at a beach club before the show.

What to expect on board

Every boat is equipped with comfortable seating, sun pads, a shaded area, and a cooler. Your skipper handles navigation and safety, so you can focus on the experience. The included drinks menu features water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. Light snacks are provided, but you are welcome to bring your own food. Larger yachts may have a galley for catering on request.

Booking your pre-concert cruise

To book, simply choose your boat and time slot. For Tier A and B boats, prices are fixed and can be paid online. For other boats, contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing. We recommend booking at least one week in advance, especially during the Starlite season (June–August). Cancellations are free up to 72 hours before departure.

For more information on all our charters, visit our main page.
